implementation.invalid_or_X_coordinates: ignored; never repaired or geocoded for the primary metric

individual_rule.W_i: half mean pairwise squared Euclidean distance among distinct-night positions; equals unbiased within-individual covariance trace

matched_cohort_rule.taxon_conflict_individuals: excluded before metric calculation under structural gate contract

between_individual_rule.B_observed: half mean pairwise squared Euclidean distance among matched individual session centroids
between_individual_rule.negative_B_debiased: retain signed estimate; do not truncate at zero

metric_qc_gate.rationale: same maximum nonpositive fraction used in the frozen synthetic support acceptance rule
metric_qc_gate.if_failed: STOP the simple coordinate-decomposition route before joining abundance; do not change m or truncate B to rescue it
required_reports: W, B_observed, centroid correction and B_debiased distributions
taxon/genus/site replication retained after metric QC

model_boundary.note: Because W and B are both in m^2, a later joint identity-scale model can compare beta_B - beta_W directly; final model contract remains separate.
